query: SELECT id, sender_user_id, status, subject, message, routing_mode, expires_at, reminder_policy, signing_options, seal_profile, completion_delivery, template_ids, version, chain_head, created_at, sent_at, completed_at, voided_at, updated_at, deleted_at, lower(subject) AS "subject_key!", (SELECT fe.folder_id FROM folder_envelopes AS fe WHERE fe.account_id = e.account_id AND fe.envelope_id = e.id AND fe.user_id = $13) AS folder_id, (SELECT r.id FROM recipients AS r JOIN users AS u ON u.id = $13 WHERE $17::bool AND r.account_id = e.account_id AND r.envelope_id = e.id AND r.status IN ('sent', 'delivered', 'authenticated', 'auto_responded') AND r.type NOT IN ('cc', 'in_person_signer') AND r.embedded_client_user_id IS NULL AND lower(r.email) = lower(u.email) ORDER BY r.routing_order, r.id LIMIT 1) AS my_recipient_id FROM envelopes AS e WHERE account_id = $1 AND (deleted_at IS NOT NULL) = $16::bool AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM envelope_states AS s WHERE s.account_id = e.account_id AND s.envelope_id = e.id) AND (cardinality($2::text[]) = 0 OR status = ANY($2)) AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR sender_user_id = $3) AND ($4::text IS NULL OR subject ILIKE $4 ESCAPE '\' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recipients AS r WHERE r.account_id = e.account_id AND r.envelope_id = e.id AND (r.name ILIKE $4 ESCAPE '\' OR r.email ILIKE $4 ESCAPE '\'))) AND ($11::text IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recipients AS r WHERE r.account_id = e.account_id AND r.envelope_id = e.id AND (r.name ILIKE $11 ESCAPE '\' OR r.email ILIKE $11 ESCAPE '\'))) AND ($5::timestamptz IS NULL OR (CASE $12::text WHEN 'created_at' THEN created_at WHEN 'sent_at' THEN sent_at WHEN 'completed_at' THEN completed_at ELSE updated_at END) >= $5) AND ($6::timestamptz IS NULL OR (CASE $12::text WHEN 'created_at' THEN created_at WHEN 'sent_at' THEN sent_at WHEN 'completed_at' THEN completed_at ELSE updated_at END) < $6) AND ($14::text = 'any' OR ($14::text = 'none' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM folder_envelopes AS fe WHERE fe.account_id = e.account_id AND fe.envelope_id = e.id AND fe.user_id = $13)) OR ($14::text = 'in' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM folder_envelopes AS fe WHERE fe.account_id = e.account_id AND fe.envelope_id = e.id AND fe.user_id = $13 AND fe.folder_id = $15::uuid))) AND (NOT $17::bool OR (status IN ('sent', 'delivered') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recipients AS r JOIN users AS u ON u.id = $13 WHERE r.account_id = e.account_id AND r.envelope_id = e.id AND r.status IN ('sent', 'delivered', 'authenticated', 'auto_responded') AND r.type NOT IN ('cc', 'in_person_signer') AND r.embedded_client_user_id IS NULL AND lower(r.email) = lower(u.email)))) AND (NOT $7::bool OR (updated_at, id) > ($8, $9::uuid)) ORDER BY updated_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT $10
